bio: The fantastic location on the lake is a draw in itself – a spot on the lovely terrace with a view of the water is of course particularly sought after! But the interior of this bright, elegant restaurant inside the hotel of the same name is also appealing – the floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the lake can be opened up. The cuisine is based on classical and international influences, here and there with an Asian touch, and often on regional products. Chic bar and relaxed outdoor lounge....
